recipes.title: Halal-cart chicken & rice
recipes.subtitle: Garlic-herb white sauce · warm chickpeas & carrots
recipes.description: Golden spiced chicken and yellow rice with a generous fresh mix of finely chopped lettuce and tomato, plus a loose garlic-herb white sauce. Warm lemony chickpeas and carrots alongside.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
80 ml water (or your rice packet's ratio)

ingredients.group: Garlic & herb white sauce — use all of it
items: 3 g garlic, crushed to a paste
45–60 ml cold water (start with the lower amount)
60 g cooked chickpeas, drained; unsalted or no-added-salt
100 g carrot, peeled and finely diced

ingredients.group: Fresh lettuce & tomato, plus shared seasoning
items: 60 g iceberg lettuce, very finely shredded, then cross-chopped short
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across chicken, rice, sauce and side (about a scant ¼ tsp fine salt; weigh if possible)

steps: Wash and dry the vegetables. Finely dice the tomato. Finely shred and shorten the lettuce. Peel and finely dice the carrot. Mince the garlic; crush the sauce portion to a paste. Use a separate board for raw chicken.

Heat oven to 210°C / 190°C fan. Toss carrots with their oil, paprika and some salt. Spread on a lined tray. Roast 20–25 minutes, turning halfway. Add cooked chickpeas for the final 5 minutes. Finish with the side’s lemon and parsley. Keep warm.

Rinse and drain the rice. Add water, turmeric and some salt to a small lidded pan. Follow the packet’s water ratio if different. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest off the heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff.
Whisk all sauce ingredients together, starting with the lower water amount. Add water gradually, up to the listed maximum, until it pours easily. Chill while the chicken cooks. Stir before serving.

Pat chicken dry and cut into bite-sized chunks. Toss with its oil, lemon, garlic, spices and remaining salt. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high. Add chicken in one uncrowded layer. Sear 2–3 minutes; turn and cook another 5–7 minutes. Lower heat if spices start to burn. Check the thickest pieces reach 74°C with a thermometer. Rest 3 minutes.
Check rice and carrots are tender. Chop any oversized chicken pieces smaller on a clean board. Keep lettuce and tomato chilled until plating.

Fill half the plate with lettuce and tomato. Put rice and chicken on the other half. Drizzle about two-fifths of the sauce over chicken and vegetables. Serve the rest alongside. Serve the warm chickpea-carrot side in its own bowl.

tl.description: Golden na manok at dilaw na kanin, may masaganang sariwang kamatis at pinong letsugas, at malabnaw na garlic-herb white sauce. Hiwalay ang mainit na chickpeas at carrot na may lemon.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
35 g basmati rice, timbang bago lutuin
80 ml tubig (o ayon sa ratio sa pakete)

ingredients.group: Puting sarsa na may bawang at herbs — gamitin lahat
items: 45–60 ml malamig na tubig (magsimula sa mas mababang dami)

ingredients.group: Mainit na chickpeas at carrot — hiwalay na ihain
items: 60 g lutong chickpeas, pinatulo, walang dagdag na asin
100 g carrot, binalatan at pinong diced

ingredients.group: Sariwang letsugas at kamatis, at asin para sa buong recipe
items: 60 g iceberg lettuce, napakapinong hiniwa at pinaikli pa nang pahalang
1 g asin SA BUONG RECIPE, hatiin sa manok, kanin, sarsa at side (halos kulang na ¼ tsp pinong asin; timbangin kung maaari)

steps: Hugasan at patuyuin ang gulay. Hiwain nang pinong dice ang kamatis. Hiwain nang napakapino at paikliin ang letsugas. Balatan at hiwain nang pinong dice ang carrot. Tadtarin ang bawang; durugin na paste ang para sa sarsa. Gumamit ng hiwalay na sangkalan para sa hilaw na manok.

Painitin ang oven sa 210°C / 190°C fan. Ihalo sa carrot ang nakalaang oil, paprika at kaunting asin. Ikalat sa tray na may baking paper. I-roast nang 20–25 minuto; baligtarin sa kalagitnaan. Idagdag ang lutong chickpeas sa huling 5 minuto. Ihalo ang nakalaang lemon at parsley. Panatilihing mainit.

Banlawan at patuluin ang bigas. Ilagay ang tubig, turmeric at kaunting asin sa maliit na kaserolang may takip. Sundin ang water ratio sa pakete kung iba. Pakuluan. Takpan at hinaan ang apoy; lutuin nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang nakatakip, walang apoy, sa loob ng 10 minuto. Buhaghagin.

Haluin ang lahat ng sangkap ng sarsa; magsimula sa mas mababang dami ng tubig. Unti-unting dagdagan ng tubig hanggang madaling ibuhos, nang hindi lalampas sa nakalistang maximum. Ilagay sa refrigerator habang niluluto ang manok. Haluin bago ihain.

Patuyuin ang manok at hiwain sa mga tipak na kasya sa isang subo. Ihalo ang nakalaang oil, lemon, bawang, spices at natitirang asin. Painitin ang non-stick na kawali sa medium-high. Ilagay ang manok sa isang layer na hindi siksikan. I-sear nang 2–3 minuto; baligtarin at lutuin pa nang 5–7 minuto. Hinaan kung nasusunog ang spices. Gamit ang thermometer, tiyaking 74°C ang pinakamakapal na piraso. Ipahinga nang 3 minuto.
Tiyaking malambot ang kanin at carrot. Paliitin ang malalaking piraso ng manok sa malinis na sangkalan. Panatilihing malamig ang letsugas at kamatis hanggang ihain.

Ilagay ang letsugas at kamatis sa kalahati ng plato. Ilagay ang kanin at manok sa kabilang kalahati. Ibuhos ang mga dalawang-kalima ng sarsa sa manok at gulay. Ihain ang natira sa tabi. Ihain ang mainit na chickpea-carrot side sa hiwalay na mangkok.

components.body: 200 g raw chicken breast and 35 g dry basmati. Cumin, coriander, oregano and garlic; chopped into comfortable bites.

components.title: All the white sauce
components.body: 120 g of 2% Greek yogurt, loosened with 45–60 ml water, makes roughly 180–195 g of pourable garlic-herb sauce. Drizzle some and serve the rest alongside.

components.title: A proper fresh portion
components.body: 140 g tomato and 60 g lettuce: finely diced tomato and very fine, short lettuce shreds. Give the fresh vegetables roughly half the plate.

components.title: Warm chickpeas & carrots
components.body: A separate lemony, smoky side for fibre. This is the proposed side to try; flag it in Review if it doesn't appeal.

visual.adjustment: The chickpea side supplies much of this meal’s fibre. If the portion feels too much, flag it in Review so we can adjust gradually. Changing the side also changes the nutrition total.
visual.basis: Rounded estimates use generic USDA-style composition, raw chicken and rice weights, cooked chickpea weight and plain 2% Greek yogurt. About 18 g fat per dinner. Brands and cooking yields vary; this is not a lab analysis. Rice and chickpeas both count towards carbohydrate. Contains milk. This dinner has not yet been taste-tested.

recipes.title: Saucy chicken curry & rice
recipes.subtitle: Tomato-ginger gravy · green beans in the curry
recipes.description: Chicken in a generous onion-tomato gravy, fragrant with ginger and warm spices. Short-cut green beans cook in the sauce; rice comes alongside.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
150 g green beans, trimmed and cut short
200 ml water, plus a splash if needed
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across curry and rice

steps: Wash the vegetables. Finely dice onion and tomato. Trim and cut green beans short. Mince ginger and garlic. Cut chicken into bite-sized chunks on a separate board.
Rinse rice. Add its water and a little of the salt. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest covered, off the heat, for 10 minutes. Follow packet ratios if different.

Heat oil over medium. Soften onion for 7–8 minutes. Add ginger and garlic; stir for 1 minute. Add cumin, coriander, turmeric and chilli; stir for 30 seconds. Add tomato and remaining salt. Cook 6–8 minutes until soft.

Add chicken, beans and the gravy water. Stir. Partly cover; simmer gently for 12–15 minutes. Check chicken reaches 74°C and beans are tender. Add a splash of water if needed: gravy should pour easily.
Turn heat off. Whisk a spoonful of warm gravy into the yogurt. Stir yogurt into the curry with garam masala and lemon. Do not boil. Add coriander. Serve all the curry and sauce with rice alongside.

tl.description: Manok sa masaganang onion-tomato gravy na may luya at mababangong spices. Kasama sa sarsa ang maiikling hiwa ng green beans; nasa tabi ang kanin.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
150 g green beans, tinanggalan ng dulo at hiniwa nang maikli
200 ml tubig, dagdagan nang kaunti kung kailangan
1 g asin SA KABUUAN, paghatiin sa curry at kanin
40 g basmati rice, timbang bago lutuin
90 ml tubig, o ratio sa pakete

steps: Hugasan ang gulay. Pinong i-dice ang sibuyas at kamatis. Putulin ang dulo at hiwain nang maikli ang green beans. Tadtarin ang luya at bawang. Hiwain ang manok sa maliliit na chunks sa hiwalay na sangkalan.

Hugasan ang bigas. Idagdag ang tubig nito at kaunting asin. Pakuluan; takpan at lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Sundin ang ratio sa pakete kung iba.

Painitin ang mantika sa katamtamang apoy. Palambutin ang sibuyas nang 7–8 minuto. Idagdag ang luya at bawang; haluin nang 1 minuto. Idagdag ang cumin, coriander, turmeric at chilli; haluin nang 30 segundo. Idagdag ang kamatis at natitirang asin. Lutuin nang 6–8 minuto hanggang lumambot.

Idagdag ang manok, green beans at tubig para sa gravy. Haluin. Bahagyang takpan; pakuluin nang marahan nang 12–15 minuto. Tiyaking 74°C ang manok at malambot ang green beans. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan: dapat madaling ibuhos ang gravy.

Patayin ang apoy. Haluin ang isang kutsarang mainit na gravy sa yogurt. Ihalo ang yogurt sa curry kasama ang garam masala at lemon. Huwag pakuluan. Idagdag ang coriander. Ihain ang buong curry at sarsa, katabi ang kanin.

recipes.title: Tender kofta & potatoes
recipes.subtitle: Tomato-onion sauce · fresh chopped salad
recipes.description: Soft, gently mixed beef kofta with golden potatoes and plenty of tomato-onion sauce. A fresh chopped salad on the side.

items: 180 g halal lean beef mince, 5% fat, raw
30 g grated onion, weighed after gently squeezing
250 g potato, small chunks, skin on
4 g olive oil for the pan
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across kofta, potatoes and sauce
60 g iceberg lettuce, finely shredded and cut short

steps: Heat oven to 210°C / 190°C fan. Wash vegetables. Cut potatoes small. Finely dice tomatoes and sauce onion. Finely shred and shorten lettuce. Mince garlic and parsley. Soak oats in their water for 5 minutes. Grate and gently squeeze kofta onion.
Toss potatoes with their oil, paprika and some salt. Spread on a lined tray. Roast 30–35 minutes, turning halfway. Cook until golden and tender.

Combine beef, soaked oats, squeezed onion, parsley, garlic and spices. Add a little of the salt. Fold just until combined; do not knead. Shape into five loose, short ovals per serving. Do not squeeze tight.

Heat pan oil over medium-high. Brown kofta for 2 minutes per side; lift out. Lower heat. Soften sauce onion for 5 minutes; add garlic for 30 seconds. Add sauce tomato and remaining salt. Cook 5 minutes, then add water.
Return kofta to sauce. Cover and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes. Check the centre of the kofta reaches 71°C. Loosen sauce with a splash of water if needed.
Dress salad tomato and lettuce with lemon. Serve kofta with all the sauce, potatoes alongside and salad in its own bowl.

tl.description: Malambot na beef kofta, marahang hinalo, may golden na patatas at maraming tomato-onion sauce. May sariwang chopped salad sa tabi.

items: 180 g halal lean beef mince, 5% fat, hilaw
30 g gadgad na sibuyas, timbang matapos pigain nang marahan
250 g patatas, maliliit na chunks, may balat
4 g olive oil para sa patatas
4 g olive oil para sa kawali
1 g asin SA KABUUAN, paghatiin sa kofta, patatas at sarsa
60 g iceberg lettuce, pinong shredded at pinaikli

steps: Painitin ang oven sa 210°C / 190°C fan. Hugasan ang gulay. Hiwain nang maliit ang patatas. Pinong i-dice ang kamatis at sibuyas para sa sarsa. Pinong i-shred at paikliin ang lettuce. Tadtarin ang bawang at parsley. Ibabad ang oats sa tubig nito nang 5 minuto. Gadgarin at marahang pigain ang sibuyas para sa kofta.
Ihalo ang patatas sa mantika nito, paprika at kaunting asin. Ikalat sa tray na may liner. I-roast nang 30–35 minuto; baligtarin sa kalagitnaan. Lutuin hanggang golden at malambot.

Pagsamahin ang beef, binabad na oats, pinigang sibuyas, parsley, bawang at spices. Lagyan ng kaunting asin. Marahang ihalo hanggang magsama; huwag masahin. Hubugin sa limang maikling oval bawat serving. Huwag siksikin.

Painitin ang mantika sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. I-brown ang kofta nang 2 minuto bawat panig; iahon. Hinaan ang apoy. Palambutin ang sibuyas nang 5 minuto; idagdag ang bawang nang 30 segundo. Idagdag ang kamatis para sa sarsa at natitirang asin. Lutuin nang 5 minuto, saka idagdag ang tubig.
Ibalik ang kofta sa sarsa. Takpan at pakuluin nang marahan nang 8–10 minuto. Tiyaking 71°C ang gitna ng kofta. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan para lumabnaw ang sarsa.

recipes.title: Garlic roast chicken & potatoes
recipes.subtitle: Golden vegetables · pan juices · lemon-yogurt sauce
recipes.description: Juicy garlic-paprika chicken with crisp-edged potatoes, caramelised carrots and broccoli with browned, crisp tips. Vegetables roast on their own hot tray; pan juices go over the chicken, with lemon-yogurt sauce alongside.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
230 g potato, small chunks, skin on
60 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, no alcohol
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across chicken, vegetables and sauce
2 g garlic, crushed to a paste

steps: Heat oven to 220°C / 200°C fan with a roomy metal vegetable tray inside. Wash and thoroughly dry vegetables. Cut potatoes small, carrots into thin half-moons and broccoli into small florets. Mince garlic.

Mix paprika, thyme and pepper; reserve half for chicken. Toss potatoes with half the vegetable oil, some spice mix and salt. Spread on the hot tray, cut sides down. Roast 15 minutes. Toss carrots and broccoli with remaining vegetable oil, vegetable spices and some salt.
On a separate board, gently flatten the thick end of the breast. Rub with chicken oil, garlic, reserved spices and some salt. Put chicken in its own small roasting dish.

Turn potatoes. Add carrots and broccoli to the vegetable tray with space between pieces. Roast vegetables and the separate chicken dish for 18–22 minutes. Remove chicken at 74°C; rest 5 minutes on a clean plate. Turn vegetables once; pull out browned, tender pieces. Give pale pieces 3–5 minutes more.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, sauce garlic, remaining salt and the lower water amount. Add extra water as needed for a loose drizzle. Simmer chicken juices with the stock in a small pan for 2–3 minutes.
Cut rested chicken into chunks; pour its pan juices over it. Keep vegetables out of the juices to preserve their crisp edges. Serve yogurt sauce alongside for dipping.

tl.description: Juicy na garlic-paprika chicken, crispy na gilid ng patatas, caramelised na carrot at broccoli na browned at crispy ang dulo. Hiwalay ang mainit na tray ng gulay; sa manok ang pan juices, may lemon-yogurt sauce sa tabi.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
230 g patatas, maliliit na chunks, may balat
8 g olive oil para sa gulay
2 g olive oil para sa manok
60 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, walang alcohol
1 g asin SA KABUUAN, paghatiin sa manok, gulay at sarsa

steps: Painitin ang oven sa 220°C / 200°C fan, kasama ang maluwag na metal tray para sa gulay. Hugasan at patuyuing mabuti ang gulay. Hiwain nang maliit ang patatas, manipis na half-moon ang carrot at maliliit na florets ang broccoli. Tadtarin ang bawang.

Paghaluin ang paprika, thyme at pepper; itabi ang kalahati para sa manok. Ihalo ang patatas sa kalahati ng mantika para sa gulay, kaunting spice mix at asin. Ikalat sa mainit na tray, nakadapa ang hiwang bahagi. I-roast nang 15 minuto. Ihalo ang carrot at broccoli sa natitirang mantika at spices para sa gulay, at kaunting asin.

Sa hiwalay na sangkalan, marahang pantayin ang makapal na bahagi ng chicken breast. Ipahid ang mantika para sa manok, bawang, itinabing spices at kaunting asin. Ilagay ang manok sa sarili nitong maliit na roasting dish.

Baligtarin ang patatas. Idagdag ang carrot at broccoli sa tray ng gulay, may pagitan ang mga piraso. I-roast ang gulay at hiwalay na dish ng manok nang 18–22 minuto. Alisin ang manok sa 74°C; ipahinga nang 5 minuto sa malinis na plato. Baligtarin ang gulay nang isang beses; alisin ang browned at malambot na piraso. Iwan pa nang 3–5 minuto ang maputla.

Haluin ang yogurt, lemon, bawang para sa sarsa, natitirang asin at mas kaunting dami ng tubig. Dagdagan ng tubig kung kailangan para madaling ibuhos. Pakuluin nang marahan ang juices ng manok at stock sa maliit na kaserola nang 2–3 minuto.
Hiwain sa chunks ang ipinahingang manok; ibuhos dito ang pan juices. Ihiwalay ang gulay sa pan juices para manatiling crispy ang mga gilid. Ihain sa tabi ang yogurt sauce para sa pagsawsaw.

recipes.title: Basil pesto chicken pasta
recipes.subtitle: Garlic, toasted almonds & parmesan · fresh tomato
recipes.description: Glossy basil pesto pasta with golden chicken, courgette and spinach. Garlic, toasted almonds, lemon and parmesan bring the flavour; fresh diced tomato finishes it.

items: 180 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
55 g regular fusilli pasta, dry weight
3 g olive oil for the pan
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across chicken, vegetables and pesto
10 g parmesan-style hard cheese, halal-certified or microbial/vegetarian rennet

steps: Wash vegetables. Finely dice tomato; cut courgette into small half-moons. Grate cheese. Peel garlic. Pick basil leaves. Cut chicken into bite-sized chunks on a separate board.

Toast almonds in a dry pan over medium-low for 3–4 minutes; cool. Finely blend almonds, basil, garlic, half the cheese, lemon, pesto oil and a little salt. Add a splash of water if needed to blend. Set aside.
Boil pasta in unsalted water until just tender, following packet timing. Reserve the listed pasta water before draining.

Season chicken with pepper and some salt. Heat pan oil over medium-high. Sear chicken for 2–3 minutes; turn and cook another 5–7 minutes, to 74°C. Lift chicken out. Pat courgette dry; sear in one layer for 4–5 minutes, turning once. Add spinach and remaining salt; wilt for 1 minute.
Turn heat off. Add pasta, chicken and all the pesto. Toss with the lower amount of pasta water. Add more as needed. Keep the sauce loose and glossy; do not boil the pesto.
Spoon into a warm bowl. Top with all the fresh tomato and remaining cheese. Serve immediately, while the sauce is glossy.

tl.description: Glossy basil pesto pasta na may golden na manok, courgette at spinach. Malasa mula sa bawang, toasted almonds, lemon at parmesan; may sariwang diced na kamatis.

items: 180 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
55 g regular fusilli pasta, timbang bago lutuin
3 g olive oil para sa kawali
1 g asin SA KABUUAN, paghatiin sa manok, gulay at pesto
10 g parmesan-style hard cheese, halal-certified o microbial/vegetarian rennet
3 g olive oil para sa pesto

steps: Hugasan ang gulay. Pinong i-dice ang kamatis; hiwain ang courgette sa maliliit na half-moon. Gadgarin ang keso. Balatan ang bawang. Pitasin ang dahon ng basil. Hiwain ang manok sa maliliit na chunks sa hiwalay na sangkalan.

I-toast ang almonds sa tuyong kawali sa katamtaman hanggang mahinang apoy nang 3–4 minuto; palamigin. Pinong i-blend ang almonds, basil, bawang, kalahati ng keso, lemon, mantika para sa pesto at kaunting asin. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan sa pag-blend. Itabi.
Pakuluan ang pasta sa tubig na walang asin hanggang lumambot, ayon sa oras sa pakete. Itabi ang nakalistang dami ng tubig ng pasta bago salain.

Timplahan ang manok ng pepper at kaunting asin. Painitin ang mantika sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. I-sear ang manok nang 2–3 minuto; baligtarin at lutuin pa nang 5–7 minuto, hanggang 74°C. Iahon ang manok. Patuyuin ang courgette; i-sear nang hindi nagsasapawan sa loob ng 4–5 minuto, baligtarin nang isang beses. Idagdag ang spinach at natitirang asin; palantahin nang 1 minuto.

Patayin ang apoy. Idagdag ang pasta, manok at lahat ng pesto. Ihalo ang mas kaunting dami ng tubig ng pasta. Dagdagan kung kailangan. Panatilihing malabnaw at glossy ang sarsa; huwag pakuluan ang pesto.
Ilagay sa mainit na mangkok. Ilagay sa ibabaw ang lahat ng sariwang kamatis at natitirang keso. Ihain agad habang glossy pa ang sarsa.

recipes.title: Ajiaco chicken & potato soup
recipes.subtitle: Corn & guascas · rice, lettuce and sour cream alongside
recipes.description: A brothy, comforting take on ajiaco: chicken, soft potato and corn. Rice, finely shredded lettuce and sour cream arrive separately, ready to mix in your way.

items: 180 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
100 g floury potato, peeled and thinly sliced
100 g yellow potato or papa criolla, peeled, small chunks
80 g sweetcorn kernels, edible weight; use corn-on-cob rounds yielding this amount
500 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, no alcohol
0.5 g salt TOTAL, use only as needed after tasting stock
60 g iceberg lettuce, finely shredded and cut short

steps: Wash vegetables. Mince onion, celery and garlic very finely. Peel potatoes: thinly slice floury potato; cut yellow potato into small chunks. Use short corn-on-cob rounds; ask the grocer to cut them if needed. Finely shred and shorten lettuce; keep chilled.
Heat oil over medium-low. Add onion and celery. Cook 8–10 minutes until very soft; add a splash of water if needed. Add garlic; stir for 1 minute.

Add stock, chicken, corn, both potatoes, guascas and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer; partly cover. Cook for 18–22 minutes. Remove chicken once its centre reaches 74°C. Rest on a clean plate. Simmer soup another 10–15 minutes, until corn and potatoes are tender.

While soup simmers, rinse rice and add its water to a small lidded pan. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest covered, off the heat, for 10 minutes. Follow packet ratios if different.

Shred chicken into short pieces and return it to the soup. Mash a few soft potato slices against the pot; leave some chunks. Add water if needed to keep it brothy. Heat through. Taste before adding any of the measured salt.
Ladle all the soup into a roomy bowl. Serve rice, lettuce and sour cream in three separate bowls. Mix them into the soup at the table, as you like.

tl.description: Masabaw at comforting na bersyon ng ajiaco: manok, malambot na patatas at mais. Hiwalay ang kanin, pinong shredded na lettuce at sour cream para ikaw ang maghalo.

items: 180 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
100 g floury potato, binalatan at manipis na hiniwa
100 g yellow potato o papa criolla, binalatan, maliliit na chunks
80 g sweetcorn kernels, timbang ng nakakain; gumamit ng corn-on-cob rounds na may ganitong dami
500 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, walang alcohol
0.5 g asin SA KABUUAN, gamitin lamang kung kailangan matapos tikman ang stock
25 g puting bigas, timbang bago lutuin
60 ml tubig, o ratio sa pakete
60 g iceberg lettuce, pinong shredded at pinaikli

steps: Hugasan ang gulay. Napakapinong tadtarin ang sibuyas, celery at bawang. Balatan ang patatas: manipis na hiwa sa floury potato; maliliit na chunks sa yellow potato. Gumamit ng maiikling corn-on-cob rounds; ipahiwa sa tindahan kung kailangan. Pinong i-shred at paikliin ang lettuce; panatilihing malamig.

Painitin ang mantika sa katamtaman hanggang mahinang apoy. Idagdag ang sibuyas at celery. Lutuin nang 8–10 minuto hanggang napakalambot; dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan. Idagdag ang bawang; haluin nang 1 minuto.

Idagdag ang stock, manok, mais, parehong patatas, guascas at pepper. Pakuluin nang marahan; bahagyang takpan. Lutuin nang 18–22 minuto. Alisin ang manok kapag 74°C na ang gitna. Ipahinga sa malinis na plato. Pakuluin pa nang marahan ang sopas nang 10–15 minuto, hanggang malambot ang mais at patatas.

Habang kumukulo ang sopas, hugasan ang bigas at ilagay kasama ang tubig nito sa maliit na kaserolang may takip. Pakuluan; takpan at lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Sundin ang ratio sa pakete kung iba.

Himayin ang manok sa maiikling piraso at ibalik sa sopas. Durugin ang ilang malambot na hiwa ng patatas sa gilid ng kaserola; mag-iwan ng ilang chunks. Dagdagan ng tubig kung kailangan para manatiling masabaw. Painitin nang mabuti. Tikman bago magdagdag ng nakasukat na asin.
Isandok ang buong sopas sa maluwag na mangkok. Ihain ang kanin, lettuce at sour cream sa tatlong magkahiwalay na mangkok. Ihalo sa sopas habang kumakain, ayon sa gusto.
